findings.issue: やばい directly modifies 品物 (やばい品物 'risky goods') — attributive use, as the token's own note says ('aqui qualificando 品物'). The predicate nominal of the clause is 品物 (already labeled so); calling やばい 'predicativo' is wrong.

kana reads 何時ごろ as いつごろ, but every gloss/translation says 'que horas / around what time' (clock time = なんじごろ). Reading and glosses must match: fix kana+romaji to なんじごろ (or else reword all glosses to 'quando/when').
Token 何時ごろ is read いつごろ but glossed 'around what time / por volta de que horas', which is なんじごろ. いつごろ would mean 'por volta de quando', not 'que horas'; reading contradicts its own gloss.
